Its slowest tests: test_3c_no_close_arm::test_existing_arm_dry_run_remains_byte_stable 51.6 s; test_narration_corpus::test_golden_ok_entries_remain_accepted 47.3 s; test_persona_escalation::test_persona_summary_is_json_serializable[thorough] 36.9 s (all in module fixture `summaries` setup); test_late_scene_repro::test_nonmatching_filler_preserves_authored_custody_across_2a_to_3c 16.5 s; test_3c_state_compare 16.5 s; test_3c_carried_start 16.1 s; test_scene_2a_advantages (two tests, 15.7 s and 11.4 s); test_three_c_prefix setup 11.7 s and 10.8 s. Journeys files (test_game_path_journeys 411 s, test_evidence_gap_journeys 100 s, test_canon_journey 19 s) are owned by a separate runtime-speed task: do not edit them.

RULE: keep every assertion. No test may be deleted, weakened, skipped or loosened; every test function name that exists now must still exist in the same file afterwards (the check compares the set of `def test_*` names per file against git HEAD). Only restructure for speed: (1) split one long test into parametrized cases of the same function, (2) cache expensive pure setup so it is computed once per xdist worker and shared safely (module- or session-scoped, `copy.deepcopy` for any mutable state a test might change, never share state that a test mutates), (3) make module fixtures lazy per key so a worker computes only what its tests use, (4) fix CI shard weights.

TASKS: (1) Regenerate tests/shard_durations.json from the JUnit file: keep its existing schema (`version`, `files` mapping `tests/<file>.py` to seconds) and key style, include every test file that exists now with its summed seconds (file CPU time from the JUnit testcases), drop files that no longer exist. Check tests/test_shard_balance.py and run it. Report the old and new predicted max/min shard load using `assign_test_nodes_to_shards` with 6 shards. (2) For each long test above, profile first (cProfile or --durations) and apply the smallest rule-conforming change: for test_golden_ok_entries_remain_accepted parametrize over the golden-ok corpus entries by entry id (load the corpus and verdicts once per worker with functools.cache); for the persona `summaries` fixture compute each persona lazily and once per worker (a cached function keyed by name) instead of all three in one setup; for the 3C carried-start / prefix / state-compare / byte-stable tests find the shared expensive build (for example the scripted carried prefix) and build it once per worker with a cached helper that returns deep copies; for the two scene_2a_advantages tests check whether the journey they build is the same one and share it. If a test cannot be sped up without touching its assertions, leave it and say why. (3) Measure each touched test before and after (`--durations`) and the whole-suite wall time with `-n auto` before and after; report the numbers truthfully, including no improvement.

OWNED FILES: tests/** except tests/test_game_path_journeys.py, tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py, tests/test_canon_journey.py and tests/fixtures/**. Nothing else (no storygame/**, no data/**).

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Focused: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto <files> --durations=15. FULL suite must end green: same with no file args. Ruff on Python files you touch: -m ruff check --fix then -m ruff format. Do not run uv. Tests stay hermetic (no network, no live worker). Do NOT git commit, do NOT git add -A, do NOT touch .git.

NOTES CONTRACT: speedA-notes.md with sections: SHARDS (old vs new predicted loads), CHANGES (per test: what was slow, what you changed, before/after seconds), LEFT ALONE (with reason), WALL TIME (before/after full run), OPEN QUESTIONS (or 'none'). Reply with a short summary.

RULE: PURE PERFORMANCE REFACTOR. Observable behavior must be byte-identical: same facts, same segments, same turn records, same saved snapshots. Facts remain the sole mutable truth; do not add a second source of truth. Any index or cache must be derived from the facts, invalidated or rebuilt whenever facts change (assert, retract, restore_snapshot, rollback), keyed so a stale hit is impossible, and covered by a test. No story-specific names in storygame/**. Do not change any test assertion.
